enrichment method: we employed an affinity-based ubiquitinated peptide enrichment approach to systematically quantify the change of ubiquitinome in the eWAT of Mdm2-AKI and control mice on HFD for 12 weeks.
labeling: we performed quantitative proteomics analysis in eWAT of Mdm2-AKI and control mice on HFD for 12 weeks through LC-MS/MS to system-wide identify the degradation substrates of MDM2.
